title: Quoth the Raven: Exxon Valdez
summary:
Quoth the Raven: Exxon Valdez
This week marks the 25 th anniversary of the infamous Exxon Valdez oil spill, an accident that would forever shape the marine industry. While the oil industry at large is no stranger to public scrutiny, misinformation and/or media hype, it could be argued that the tanker industry has it particularly tough. In fact, it could be concluded after the Exxon Valdez had an impact disproportionate to the actual magnitude of the spill.
